messages:
maya: FYI hit a reproducible failure in the onboarding sample: token expiry under concurrency + 429s causing duplicate side-effects. Short repro below.

tom: Can you paste the minimal repro and any 429 headers you saw?

maya: Repro: run `./repro.sh --clients=12 --token-ttl=4s`. Logs:
[2026-03-18T10:00:01Z] req=1 status=401 msg="token expired"
[2026-03-18T10:00:01Z] refresh.start user=u5
[2026-03-18T10:00:01Z] req=2 status=429 Retry-After: 1
[2026-03-18T10:00:02Z] req=3 status=429
[2026-03-18T10:00:04Z] refresh.done token=tok_a
[2026-03-18T10:00:05Z] req=4 status=200
No Idempotency-Key set. JS SDK retried 429s; Python surfaced error.

lina: Two quick fixes: (1) SDK auth helper should implement single-flight refresh so only one refresh is performed when token expired; (2) auto-attach `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` for POSTs to known safe endpoints (opt-out allowed).

lina: For 429/backoff: honor `Retry-After` if present. Otherwise use exponential backoff with full jitter: base=100ms, sleep=random(0, base * 2**attempt), max_attempts=5. Only auto-retry 429s when request is idempotent or has Idempotency-Key; expose `retryOn429` flag.

sdk-bot: Filed SDK parity ticket: DX-824 (JS/Python/Rust) to standardize 429 semantics and add `auth.singleFlight()` helper. Sample-app PR incoming with repro and local fix.

maya: I'll link the PR and backend ask: increase idempotency record TTL to >= 5 minutes to cover retry window. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
